title: Thus Spake Cargothustra
subtitle: The Rise of Nanda
blurb: Nanda is the cargo, and every need and delivery is a step in a random walk that iteration slowly narrows. Thirteen chapters, one for each C of trade, four mythic interludes, and a pirate navy at the gate.
cover_alt: A small smiling shipping container with a jagged saffron path leading up to a star beside a crescent moon
